purpose: Prospective G1->G2->G3 test in which hidden challenge custody is external and structural rules are frozen before G1.
precommit_requirements: All three challenge commitments are published before G1 candidate freeze; all three one-time-pad keys remain withheld by the external custodian.
The public challenge schema, verifier code, workflow, metric definition, residual-to-mutation compiler, and promotion rule are frozen before G1.
Human structural edits to the candidate generator/compiler are forbidden between G1 and G3; only externally returned receipts may alter descendant policy state.
Each generation candidate head SHA and file SHA-256 are frozen before that generation key is revealed.
G2 may consume only G1 external receipt plus public lineage; G3 may consume only G1/G2 external receipts plus public lineage.

metric.validated_frontier: weighted hidden-case correctness with zero claim-boundary violations; exact case weights are committed by the custodian before G1 and revealed with each challenge
metric.human_input_cost: count of post-G1 structural source edits outside generated candidate state; required value is 0 for a recursive-acceleration claim
metric.evidence_cost: number of hidden cases revealed plus independent-source/evaluator calls consumed
metric.compute_cost: candidate generation invocations + candidate hidden-evaluation invocations; wall time may be recorded but is not used as sole compute proxy
metric.productive_safety: positive validated_frontier_gain with zero rollback-class critical errors and zero claim-boundary violations

minimum: all three generations are post-freeze externally evaluated
productive_safety is true in G1, G2, and G3
at least one REMOVE or WRONG-SWAP control degrades the descendant chain
external custodian commitment/reveal hashes verify for all generations
promotion_rule.if_not_met: recursive_acceleration_proven remains false; retain the full failure trajectory.

external_custody_boundary.required_for_independent_custody: The party/model holding unrevealed keys must not disclose them to ARTE/ChatGPT/user before the corresponding candidate freeze.
external_custody_boundary.stronger_target: Custodian also controls challenge generation and independently records verifier/workflow hashes before reveal.
not_sufficient: self-generated encrypted challenge with a key known to the user/ARTE
majority vote among behaviorally equivalent evaluators
